summary: Phase A.5 items 3.4 (Investigation Replay) + 3.5 (Universal Evidence Drill-down) — frontend-only testing. 25/26 scenarios PASS. Investigation Detail Replay CTA, Investigation Replay page (scrubber, pipeline flow, step detail, Show Evidence), shared EvidenceModal from Attack Chain, MITRE chips, Timeline events, modal close via button/Escape/backdrop, tab switching (chain/raw), deep-linking to /investigations/:id/replay, and back navigation ALL work. ONE CRITICAL BUG: ComparePage crashes at runtime with 'ReferenceError: evi is not defined' — the useEvidenceModal() hook is used (evi.open on line 117, evi.modal on line 119) but never declared. This makes the /compare page throw an Uncaught runtime error and blocks the Confidence Provenance rule-fire drill-down flow (a-rule-<id> / b-rule-<id> → EvidenceModal).

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: evi is not defined — component crashes on mount. Missing `const evi = useEvidenceModal();` inside ComparePage() before the return. useEvidenceModal is imported (line 19) and evi.open/evi.modal are referenced (lines 117 and 119) but the hook is never called to create `evi`.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be exercised because ComparePage itself crashes before rendering anything. Rule-fire rows (a-rule-<id>, b-rule-<id>) never render.

action_items: Add `const evi = useEvidenceModal();` inside the ComparePage() component body in /app/frontend/src/pages/ComparePage.jsx (before the return statement, alongside the other useState hooks around lines 54-58). This is a one-line fix that will unblock the Compare page and the Confidence Provenance rule-fire → EvidenceModal flow.
critical_code_review_comments: ComparePage.jsx uses `evi.open` and `evi.modal` without ever calling useEvidenceModal() — a clear implementation miss. This should have been caught by a smoke test on /compare.
InvestigationReplayPage.jsx buildSteps() is deterministic and clean; steps array is well-formed with 10 stages on the seeded investigation.
EvidenceModal correctly handles backdrop click, Escape key, and close button — all three close paths verified.
evidenceDescriptors.js factory functions are consistent — good abstraction.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (25/26 scenarios; the one failure is the ComparePage crash blocking the Confidence Provenance rule-fire flow)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing investigation /investigations/6a72169b3d98eb14810c9506 (root_case_id 6a71df55de61c45467e3a650) per agent-to-agent context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds the missing `const evi = useEvidenceModal();` line in ComparePage, only the /compare flow needs retesting: (1) load /compare, (2) enter two case IDs (use 6a71df55de61c45467e3a650 and any other from history), (3) click Compare, (4) click a rule fire row [data-testid='a-rule-<id>' or 'b-rule-<id>'], (5) verify EvidenceModal opens with Confidence Provenance descriptor. All other Phase A.5 3.4/3.5 flows already verified passing.
rca of the issue: ComparePage.jsx imports { useEvidenceModal } from '@/components/EvidenceModal' (line 19) and calls `evi.open` (line 117) and renders `{evi.modal}` (line 119), but the local const `evi` is never declared via `const evi = useEvidenceModal();`. Reproduction: log in as admin → navigate to /compare → Uncaught ReferenceError: evi is not defined at ComparePage. Mitigation: add `const evi = useEvidenceModal();` inside the ComparePage component body (near the other useState declarations, before the return).
